text: Workflows automatically resume exactly where they left off after crashes, network failures, or infra outages
quote: Temporal delivers crash-proof execution by guaranteeing that applications resume exactly where they left off after crashes, network failures, or infrastructure outages

text: Activities (single actions like calling a service or sending email) are automatically retried on failure without extra code
quote: Temporal's default behavior is to automatically retry an Activity that fails, so transient or intermittent failures require no action on your part.

text: Activities are written as ordinary functions/methods performing a single well-defined action
quote: An Activity is a normal function or method that executes a single, well-defined action (either short or long running), such as calling another service, transcoding a media file, or sending an email message.

text: Schedules let you start a Workflow Execution automatically at specific times, similar to but more flexible than cron
quote: A Schedule contains instructions for starting a Workflow Execution at specific times.

text: Running workflows can receive Signals, Queries, and Updates sent from outside
quote: Temporal supports three types of messages: Signals, Queries, and Updates

text: Each workflow type can declare a Versioning Behavior (Pinned or Auto-Upgrade) to control how in-flight runs handle new code
quote: You can declare each Workflow type to have a Versioning Behavior, either Pinned or Auto-Upgrade, in your Workflow config

text: Web UI shows Workflow Execution state and metadata for debugging
quote: The Temporal Web UI provides users with Workflow Execution state and metadata for debugging purposes.

text: Long-running, stateful agent loops that call LLMs and tools and resume exactly where they left off after a failure
quote: Long-running, stateful agent loops that call LLMs and tools, wait on humans, and pick up exactly where they left off after a failure.

text: Agent workflows can wait on human input/approval and resume when it arrives
quote: Long-running, stateful agent loops that call LLMs and tools, wait on humans, and pick up exactly where they left off after a failure.

text: LLM/model calls run as Activities so they retry durably, aren't repeated on replay, and agents survive Worker restarts for extended runs
quote: model calls are executed as Activities, so they retry durably and are not repeated during Workflow replay. Your agents survive Worker restarts and can run for extended periods without losing state.

text: Official example shows building a durable agentic loop in Python using Claude tool calling with Temporal
quote: Build a durable agentic loop in Python with Claude tool calling and Temporal.

text: CLI includes a local development service (temporal server start-dev) for fast local feedback while building/testing
quote: The CLI includes a local Temporal development service for fast feedback while building or testing your application.

text: A single command starts a complete local Temporal Service including the Web UI
quote: This starts a complete Temporal Service with Web UI on your local machine.

text: CLI is distributed for macOS, Linux, Windows, and as a Docker image
quote: The CLI is available for macOS, Linux, and Windows, or as a Docker image.

text: Test server supports time-skipping, enabling fast end-to-end and integration tests with Workers
quote: Because the test server supports skipping time, use the test server for both end-to-end and integration tests with Workers.

text: Production deployment supported via Docker, Kubernetes, or manual setup of a self-hosted Temporal Service
quote: Deployment: Choose a deployment approach (Docker, Kubernetes, or manual) and set up a production-ready Temporal Service.

text: Serverless Workers for AWS Lambda let Temporal control scaling and lifecycle, auto-scaling with no infrastructure to manage
quote: Serverless Workers for AWS Lambda allows Temporal to control the scaling and lifecycle of Workers running as Lambda functions, enabling direct responses to available work and automatic autoscaling without any infrastructure to manage.

text: Serverless Workers for Google Cloud Run let Temporal control autoscaling of Worker Pools
quote: Serverless Workers for Google Cloud Run allows Temporal to control the scaling of Worker Pools in Cloud Run, allowing for direct responses to available work and more efficient autoscaling.

text: Guidance for querying Task Queue info and tuning Worker/Task Queue processing to manage resources effectively
quote: Use the pages in this guide for practical methods for querying Task Queue information, and strategies for tuning Workers and Task Queue processing so you manage your resources effectively.

text: OpenMetrics Quickstart streams metrics into Datadog, Elastic, Grafana Cloud, New Relic, ClickStack, or self-hosted Prometheus
quote: Start with the OpenMetrics Quickstart to create a Service Account, generate an API key, and stream metrics into Datadog, Elastic, Grafana Cloud, New Relic, ClickStack, or self-hosted Prometheus in about 5 minutes.

text: Temporal Cloud offers Multi-Cloud & Multi-Region deployment options
quote: 99.9% SLA, 99.99% HA options Multi-Cloud & Multi-Region User Roles Service Accounts & API Keys Audit Logging

text: Temporal Cloud supports Service Accounts and API Keys for access control
quote: 99.9% SLA, 99.99% HA options Multi-Cloud & Multi-Region User Roles Service Accounts & API Keys Audit Logging

text: Nexus lets teams selectively expose functionality for other teams to discover and reuse without exposing internal implementation
quote: Nexus lets teams selectively expose functionality that other teams can discover and reuse, without exposing their internal implementation details.

text: Temporal Cloud provides provable security by orchestrating encrypted workflows without ever accessing sensitive customer data
quote: Learn how Temporal Cloud provides provable security by design - orchestrating encrypted workflows without ever accessing your sensitive data.

text: SaaS offering includes security features like mTLS, end-to-end encryption, and enterprise compliance
quote: Explore the security features of our SaaS offering, including mTLS, end-to-end encryption, and enterprise compliance.

text: Temporal Cloud is certified for SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA, and CCPA compliance
quote: SOC 2 Type II GDPR HIPAA CCPA

text: Projects organize Temporal Cloud resources including namespaces and Nexus endpoints
quote: Projects provide a first-class way to organize Temporal Cloud resources including namespaces, Nexus endpoints, and more.
